summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 261,349.498 Class I shares at approximately $29.25 per share for $7.644 million in its continuous private offering. The filing also updates net asset value ($29.25/Class I share) and offering status. This is a routine periodic update of a continuous offering, not a standalone special situation. No unusual terms, discounts, or structural changes are present. The registrant is simply issuing shares under Regulation D. No other material event is disclosed.
